lines.text: Two days before the holidays, Mark realized he had nothing for Dan,
the friend who drags him up every trail.
So he printed Dan a whole year of hiking:
a planner with a hike for every month, and a hike-a-week challenge.
He wrote their first trail on the gift page and cut out the tag.
On January first, they were at the trailhead together.
Save this for your gift list.
